title: Can I buy a double electric pump in HK?
label: multiples

posts.body:
The Medela agent in Hong Kong both rents and sells breast pumps. I know that they sell the Lactina and the Symphony pumps. The Hong Kong Medela Agent is:

Meridian Hong Kong Limited

21/F., Tins Enterprises Centre

777 Lai Chi Kok Road

Cheung Sha Wan

Kowloon

Tel: (+852) 2328-2662

Fax: (+852) 2358-0263

Email: [email protected]

Web-site: http://www.meridianhk.com.hk/

Meridian is owned by Celki Medical Company which also own the Celki Home Health Care Centres (CHHCC)

Their shops are:

Causeway Bay:

Unit 2102, 21/F, Causeway Bay Plaza 1, 489 Hennessy Road, Causeway Bay

Tel: 2915-3388 Fax: 2574-0168

North Point:

Shop 111, G/F, Metropole Department Store, 416-426 King's Road, North Point

Tel: 2555-9388 Fax: 2590-0955

Tsim Sha Tsui:

Shop G34, Tung Ying Building, 100 Nathan Road, Tsim Sha Tsui

Tel: 2191-9122 Fax: 2191-9199

There are some shops in the New Territories too. Please look on the web site for these.

posts.body: Ameda products are also rented and sold in HK via Homecare Medical www.homecare-medical.com, tel 2402 2188. They have a shop in Causeway Bay as well as Kowloon. Apparently the Lactoline model is the same as what is known in the US as the Ameda Purely Yours, and it costs $1380 to buy which I think is a bit cheaper than the equivalent Medela product (Pump in Style). They also rent hospital grade pumps.

I saw the Avent ISIS duo, which is their new double electric at Mothercare ... can't remember the price, but am considering it for myself in January ... I do remember with my first attempts at pumping (a few years ago) that everybody reacts differently to different pumps ... i just couldn't get the medela to work for me that time, but the avent (single manual) worked like magic ... 

best of luck!!!

posts.body: Has anyone bought a Pump In Style (medela) in HK, and if so how much did you pay for it? Is HK$3900 the best price in HK?
posts.body_with_quotes: Has anyone bought a Pump In Style (medela) in HK, and if so how much did you pay for it? Is HK$3900 the best price in HK?

posts.body:
When I bought one (2 yrs ago) it was $3900 at B2B and at Meridian. Outrageous mark-up by both companies, given what it sells for in the UK/US/Aust. Nothing like encouraging people to breastfeed...

I also got an Avent Isis pump (manual) - it's very good once you get used to it, and generally I got as much milk as from the PIS. The PIS advantage is that you can do other stuff at the same time as pumping (internet, knitting, eating, drinking tequila).
